title: Trump admin sues Utah to save Kalshi from the state's total ban on gambling
gist: The CFTC sued Utah, its 10th state lawsuit, to block Utah's state-court bid to shut down Kalshi under its constitutional gambling ban, after a federal judge already ruled the CEA doesn't preempt Utah law. With the Third Circuit siding with prediction markets and the Sixth and Ninth against, a Supreme Court resolution looks likely, backed by 39 states plus DC.

insights.claim: The CFTC has now sued 10 states, including Utah, Arizona, Connecticut, Illinois, Kentucky, Minnesota, New Mexico, New York, Rhode Island and Wisconsin, to stop them enforcing gambling laws against CFTC-registered prediction markets.

insights.claim: The core legal questions are whether prediction-market event contracts qualify as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act and whether CFTC swap jurisdiction preempts state gambling laws.
